title: Fix Android crash on any icon click (DOMException: removeChild) and localize crash UI to English

requirements.text: Fix the Android/Chrome runtime crash that occurs immediately when the user taps any icon-based UI control anywhere in the app (e.g., bottom navigation tabs, header icons/buttons), which triggers a DOMException with message similar to: "Failed to execute 'removeChild' on 'Node': The node to be removed is not a child of this node."

quotes: Quand je clique sur nimporte quelle icone.
Échec de l'exécution de 'removeChild' sur 'Node' : le nœud à supprimer n'est pas un enfant de ce nœud.

acceptanceCriteria: On Android Chrome, tapping each bottom navigation tab (Dashboard, Calendar, Journal, Reports) no longer triggers the ErrorBoundary and does not freeze the UI.
On Android Chrome, tapping header icon/buttons (e.g., login/logout button with icon) no longer triggers the ErrorBoundary.
No DOMException removeChild error is emitted in the browser console during these interactions.

requirements.text: Add a small, explicit regression test checklist and in-app debug logging (console only) around tab switching and icon-button clicks to help confirm the fix on Android, without exposing any extra UI to end users.

quotes: Quand je clique sur nimporte quelle icone.

acceptanceCriteria: A developer can reproduce/verify the fix using a short documented checklist (e.g., steps to tap each icon-based control).
Console logs (only) clearly indicate which control was tapped and which tab was requested, without logging sensitive user data.
No additional debug UI is visible to end users in production screens.

requirements.text: Update the global crash screen (ErrorBoundary) user-facing text to English (title, description, and buttons), while still showing the underlying error message details for troubleshooting.

quotes: Use English for any user-facing text in the build request.

acceptanceCriteria: When the ErrorBoundary is shown, the title/description/buttons are in English (e.g., "Something went wrong", "Reload app", "Go back").
The technical error message text (e.g., the DOMException message) remains visible in the details section as it is today.
The ErrorBoundary remains recoverable via reload and back actions.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn components are read-only and must be composed, not edited).
Do not modify immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
nonGoals: Do not add new navigation features or new tabs; only fix the crash and improve crash-screen localization.
Do not change backend canister logic or data schemas as part of this fix.
